channel.title: Booked: First Day In
channel.desc: In Flagler, FL officers detain a person driving under the influence of drugs and an out-of-towner gets brought in for possession with intent to sell after a tense standoff with the police. Meanwhile, in Modesto, CA a teenage couple gets their first taste of jail life after an ill-fated motorcycle joyride.
